title: Araghchi: Iran’s Steel Industry Remains Standing Despite Enemy Attacks
dek: Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi said Iran's steel industry remains standing despite enemy attacks, according to WANA News Agency.
summary: WANA News Agency reports that Araghchi said Iran's steel industry remains standing despite what he described as enemy attacks. The material does not detail the attacks or any damage to capacity.
whyItMatters: Iran is a significant steel and semi-finished exporter, so disruption to its industry could affect regional supply.
implications: Buyers of Iranian billets and semi-finished steel may watch for any supply interruptions; the material does not quantify impact.
